title: 5th Year Anniversary of Essência 🎊
short_description: Essência celebrates its 5th anniversary with Cacao Ceremony, Heart Concert, Ecstatic Dance and community gathering.
description:
Dear old and new friends, families, companions, dancers, yogis, light workers and Essência Lovers 🫶

💃 On the 25th of October we are celebrating our 5th birthday and the big gift to honor and serve this magical land every day. We invite you to share this special day with us in gratitude and joy. 

🌳 We experienced so many miracles, adventures, challenges, processes, circles, waves and cosmic jokes in the last 5 years on this sacred ground. The land of Essência gave us the chance to create a heart centered community and find our soul family. 

🙏 On our birthday we will open the space with a Cacao Ceremony and a collective prayer, listen to a concert of the Essência Family and friends and dance in our Shala temple. Most important on this day is our togetherness and heart connections. 

🛖 The income of our Birthday will flow into the wooden deck and interior of our community yurte. 

🥗 There will be delicious, healthy, alive food at our soulfood bar for sale.

🐞 Kids are welcome for free and have the opportunity to play on the land and our little playground. 

We are looking forward to welcome you and cocreate a day of bliss and abundance together ♥️

#### 🕊️ Contribution: 
Early Bird until 17.10. ~ 20€, afterwards until 24.10. ~ 25€, @ the door 30€

#### 🪷 Timetable:
🌳 2:30pm ~ Cacao Ceremony & Prayer \
🦋 4:00pm ~ Heart Concert \
🌳 6:30pm ~ Ecstatic Dance \
🔥 Sauna & Sacred Fire

With Love 

The Essência Family 🙏
